Account.description: Represents a financial account within the chart of accounts.

id.description: The unique identifier assigned by QuickBooks to this object.

objectType.description: The type of object. This value is dynamically generated to represent the specific QuickBooks entity.

name.description: The primary, user-defined display name for the list object.

createdAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was originally created in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format. Note that QuickBooks Desktop typically interprets these timestamps
relative to the local timezone of the host computer where the company file resides.

updatedAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was last modified in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format.

revisionNumber.description:
The current QuickBooks-assigned revision number for this object.

This value changes every time the record is modified.
When updating this object, you must provide the most recent `revisionNumber` to ensure you are
working with the latest data and to prevent optimistic concurrency errors.

fullname.description:
The fully-qualified, case-insensitive unique name of this account.

Formed by combining the names of its hierarchical parent objects with its own name, separated by colons.

parent.description:
The parent account one level above this one in the hierarchy.

If this account is at the top level, this field will be null.

sublevel.description:
The depth level of this account in the hierarchy.

A top-level account has a sublevel of 0; each subsequent sublevel increases this number by 1.

accountType.description: The classification of this account, indicating its purpose within the chart of accounts.

specialAccountType.description:
Indicates if this is an account automatically created for specific underlying purposes.
Null for standard, non-special accounts.

isTaxAccount.description: Indicates whether this account is used for tracking taxes.

accountNumber.description: The account number, which appears in the chart of accounts, reports, and graphs.

bankNumber.description: The bank account number or identifying note.

description.description: A description of this account.
description.example: "Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services purchased on credit."

balance.description: The current balance of this account only, excluding balances from any subordinate accounts.

totalBalance.description:
The combined balance of this account and all its sub-accounts.

For example, the total balance for a bank would be the total of the balances of all its sub-accounts. If it has no sub-accounts, this will match <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Account.Models.AccountDto.Balance" />.

salesTaxCode.description:
The default sales-tax code for transactions with this account.

Determines whether the transactions are taxable or non-taxable by default. This can be overridden at the transaction or transaction-line level.

taxLineDetails.description: The account's tax line details, used for tax reporting purposes.

cashFlowClassification.description: Indicates how this account is classified for cash flow reporting.

currency.description: The currency associated with the account.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the list item is currently active.

customFields.description:
Custom fields and data extensions associated with this entity. Used for tracking user-defined data beyond standard QuickBooks properties.
- **Public Fields:** Viewable and printable in the QuickBooks UI (OwnerID of "0"). Strictly limited to 255-character strings.
- **Private Fields:** Visible only to the application that created them via a specific GUID. Total private data is limited to 4096 bytes per object across all applications.
- **Inheritance:** Transaction objects automatically inherit custom fields from their associated Customer and Item records.

Address.description:
The Address object represents a physical address, which can be associated with various entities in QuickBooks, such as customers, vendors, or employees. 
It includes properties for the street address, city, state, postal code, country, and an optional note. 
The Address object is used to capture and store location information for these entities in QuickBooks.

Request model for AppliedToTxn line items.
Represents an invoice or transaction that this payment is being applied to.

AppliedToTxn.description:
Represents a transaction that a parent transaction (e.g., a Payment) has been applied to.
This element is typically found in response objects like ReceivePaymentRet or BillPaymentCheckRet.

id.description: The unique identifier for the transaction this one is applied to.

type.description: The type of transaction this one is applied to.

transactionDate.description: The date of the transaction this one is applied to.

refNumber.description: The primary reference number for the transaction this one is applied to.

balanceRemaining.description: The balance remaining on the applied-to transaction.

paymentAmount.description: The amount of the parent transaction applied to this one.

discountAmount.description: The discount amount given on the applied-to transaction.

discountAccount.description: Reference to the discount account used.

discountClass.description: Reference to the class used for the discount.

linkedTransactions.description: Other transactions linked to this applied-to transaction.

ApplyCheckToTransactionRequest.description:
Represents the ApplyCheckToTxnAdd aggregate in QBXML (SIMPLER structure for CheckAdd only).
Used for applying a check as a direct refund to customer transactions.
This is the simplified version with only TxnID and Amount.

id.description:
The id of the transaction (Invoice, Statement Charge, etc.) to apply the check to.
(Required)

amount.description:
The amount of the check to apply to this transaction.
(Optional - if not specified, QuickBooks will apply the full check amount)

ApplyToTransactionRequest.description:
Represents the AppliedToTxnAdd aggregate in QBXML (FULL structure for BillPayments).
Used for applying a payment or credit to a specific transaction (e.g., in BillPaymentCreditCardAdd, BillPaymentCheckAdd).
This is the complex version with credits and discounts.

id.description:
The TxnID of the transaction to which the payment or credit is being applied.
(Required)

paymentAmount.description:
The amount of the payment to apply to this transaction.
(Optional in schema, but typically used)

appliedCredits.description:
List of credits to set/apply to this transaction. (Optional)
<remarks>
QBD:
- Setting/Applying a credit means using an available credit to lower the balance of a transaction such as an invoice or a bill.
- Creating a credit, on the other hand, means making a credit available to be applied in the future.
</remarks>

discountAmount.description:
The amount of discount to apply.
(Optional)

discountAccountId.description:
The account to track the discount.
(Optional)

discountClassId.description:
The class to track the discount.
(Optional)

isValid.description: Validation: Must specify either PaymentAmount, AppliedCredits, DiscountAmount, or any combination.

ArRefundCreditCard.description:
Adds a credit card refund transaction that is linked to one or more QuickBooks credit memo transactions.
You can link the credit card refund to one or more of those credit transactions. Notice that this provides 
functionality over and above what the UI provides, which currently allows a user to link only one credit 
card refund to one credit transaction.

BaseUnit.description: DTO for the base unit of a UnitOfMeasureSet.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this unit-of-measure set, unique across all unit-of-measure sets. To ensure this set appears in the QuickBooks UI for companies configured with a single unit per item, prefix the name with "By the" (e.g., "By the Barrel").

**NOTE**: Unit-of-measure sets do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

abbreviation.description: The base unit's short identifier shown in the QuickBooks U/M field on transaction line items. Maximum length: 31 characters.

BaseUnitRequest.description:

- Abbreviation: Required, max length = 31

Bill.description:
An Accounts Payable (A/P) transaction representing a bill received from a vendor. 
Bills increase the amount owed to a vendor and impact the specified A/P account. 
When creating a new bill, it can be linked to existing Purchase Orders to automatically 
pull in line item data and update the Purchase Order's status to received.
Note: In some QuickBooks editions (such as Enterprise), preference settings may require 
the use of transaction dates, meaning TxnDate must be supplied even if marked optional.

ConnectionProbeResult.description:
Result of a live connectivity probe against a connection's QuickBooks Desktop.

Unlike the connection record's stored `LastConnectedAt` / `LastMetadataSyncAt`
timestamps (which only tell you a sync happened at *some* point in the past), a probe
enqueues a lightweight CompanyQuery job and waits for the QuickBooks Web Connector to
actually execute it. A non-null result therefore proves, right now, that:
  • QuickBooks Desktop is running,
  • the Web Connector is polling, and
  • the bound company file is open.

jobStartDate.description:
The date active work commenced on the job.

Must be chronologically before or equal to <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.CreateCustomerRequest.JobProjectedEndDate" /> and <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.CreateCustomerRequest.JobEndDate" />, if they are provided.

jobProjectedEndDate.description:
The estimated deadline for job completion.

Must be chronologically on or after the <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.CreateCustomerRequest.JobStartDate" />, if provided.

jobEndDate.description:
The actual date the job was finalized.

Must be chronologically on or after the <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.CreateCustomerRequest.JobStartDate" />, if provided.

jobDesc.description: A short summary outlining the scope of work for the job.

jobTypeId.description: The unique identifier categorizing the nature of the job (e.g., Commercial, Residential, Maintenance).

notes.description: An overarching internal comment or memo regarding the customer.

additionalNotes.description: A collection of individual, distinct internal notes attached to the customer record.

preferredDeliveryMethod.description: The default medium for sending invoices and estimates (e.g., Email, Mail, None).

priceLevelId.description:
The identifier for a custom pricing tier applied automatically to items sold to this customer.

Overrides standard item rates automatically on new sales forms.

externalId.description:
A globally unique identifier generated by your external application to track this record in QuickBooks Desktop.

**Important:** This field must use a GUID format, e.g., "e3b0c442-989b-464c-869d-27f12e841f3d".
Note: This field is immutable. It can only be written once during record creation and cannot be updated.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The official tax identification number (primarily utilized in UK and Canadian QBD versions).

currencyId.description:
The unique identifier of the default currency used for this customer's transactions.

Note: You must have multicurrency support enabled in QuickBooks Desktop for this field to be available.

suffix.description: A name suffix (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

printAs.description: The pager number for the primary contact.

pager.description: The pager number for the primary contact.

mobile.description: The mobile/cellular telephone number for the primary contact.

CreateCustomerTypeRequest.description:
A request model for creating a new Customer Type.
Corresponds to the CustomerTypeAdd QBXML message.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this customer type. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two customer types could both have the `name` "Healthcare", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Industry:Healthcare" and "Region:Healthcare".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this customer type is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

parentId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the parent customer type. Used for hierarchical customer types.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for ParentRef.

externalId.description:
(Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.
Implemented from ICreateRequest.

CreateDateDrivenTermRequest.description:
Placeholder request model for creating Terms.
NOTE: Terms is a READ-ONLY resource in QuickBooks - Create operations are NOT supported.
This model exists only for interface compatibility. The validator will reject all requests.

id.description: External GUID (not used - Terms cannot be created).

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this date-driven term, unique across all date-driven terms.

**NOTE**: Date-driven terms do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this date-driven term is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

discountDayOfMonth.description: The day of the month within which payment must be received to qualify for the discount specified by `discountPercentage`.

CreateDepositLineRequest.description: Defines a single Deposit Line item to be added to the Deposit (uses discriminator pattern).

paymentLine.description:
(Optional) Details for depositing a previously recorded payment (ReceivePayment, SalesReceipt).
Mutually exclusive with ManualLine.

manualLine.description:
(Optional) Details for manually depositing a fund from another source.
Mutually exclusive with PaymentLine.

CreateDepositRequest.description:
After you receive payments from customers (see ReceivePayment), you can use 
the DepositAdd request to either deposit each payment directly into a QuickBooks 
bank account or you can group payments together. You can also choose the method 
you prefer for depositing payments.
Corresponds to the DepositAdd QBXML message.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction. Defaults to today.

depositToAccountId.description:
(Required) The ListID of the bank account where the funds are deposited.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for DepositToAccountRef.

memo.description: (Optional) General memo about the Deposit. (Max 4095 characters)

cashBackInfo.description: (Optional) Information about cash back requested from the deposit total.

currencyId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the currency for the transaction.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for CurrencyRef.

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) Exchange rate if this is a foreign currency Deposit.

depositLines.description: (Optional) A list of payment and manual lines making up the total deposit amount.

externalId.description:
(Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.
Implemented from ICreateRequest.

CreateEmployeeRequest.description: Request model for creating a new employee in QuickBooks.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this employee is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

salutation.description: The employee's formal salutation title that precedes their name, such as "Mr.", "Ms.", or "Dr.".

department.description: The employee's department. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

description.description: A description of this employee. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

printAs.description: The name to use when printing this employee from QuickBooks. By default, this is the same as the `name` field.

ssn.description:
The employee's Social Security Number. The value can be with or without dashes.

**NOTE**: This field cannot be changed after the employee is created.

emergencyContacts.description: Emergency contacts for the employee (QBD only, v13.0+).

employeeType.description: The employee type. This affects payroll taxes - a statutory employee is defined as an employee by statute. Note that owners/partners are typically on the "Other Names" list in QuickBooks, but if listed as an employee their type will be `owner`.

hiredDate.description: The date this employee was hired, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

releasedDate.description: The date this employee was released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

birthDate.description: This employee's date of birth, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

accountNumber.description:
The employee's account number, which appears in the QuickBooks chart of accounts, reports, and graphs.

Note that if the "Use Account Numbers" preference is turned off in QuickBooks, the account number may not be visible in the user interface, but it can still be set and retrieved through the API.

targetBonus.description: The target bonus for this employee, represented as a decimal string. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

overtimeExemptStatus.description:
Whether this employee is exempt from overtime pay.

exempt, non_exempt

keyEmployeeStatus.description:
The status of this employee's key employee designation.

none, key_employee, not_key_employee

originalHireDate.description: The original hire date for this employee, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

adjustedServiceDate.description: The adjusted service date for this employee, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). This date accounts for previous employment periods or leaves that affect seniority.

usCitizenshipStatus.description:
The status of this employee's citizenship.

citizen, non_citizen

disabilityStatus.description:
The status of this employee's disability.

none, disabled, not_disabled

disabilityDescription.description: The description of this employee's disability.

i9OnFileStatus.description:
The status of this employee's I-9 file.

on_file, not_on_file

workAuthorizationExpirationDate.description: The expiration date of this employee's work authorization, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

usVeteranStatus.description:
Whether this employee is a U.S. veteran.

veteran, non_veteran

militaryStatus.description: This employee's military status if they are a U.S. veteran.

employeePayrollInfo.description: The payroll information for this employee.

externalId.description:
Fulfills the ICreateRequest interface.
Used for tracking the "Add" job.

GUID format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx

CreateEstimateLineGroupRequest.description:
A request DTO for adding an item group line to an Estimate.
Corresponds to EstimateLineGroupAdd.

itemGroupId.description: (Required) The ListID or FullName of the item group. (ItemGroupRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

unitOfMeasure.description: (Optional) Unit of measure for the quantity. (STRTYPE)

inventorySiteId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site. (InventorySiteRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

inventorySiteLocationId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site Location. (InventorySiteLocationRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

customFields.description: (Optional) List of custom data extensions for the group line. (DataExt)

CreateEstimateLineRequest.description:
EstimateLineAdd One line of this estimate. Compare with EstimateLineGroup, which 
represents a previously defined group of lines in the estimate. In a Mod request, 
you can add a new line by supplying a TxnLineID value of -1.

id.description: (Required for Mod) The TxnLineID of the specific line item being modified or deleted. (IDTYPE)

objectType.description: The type of object. This value is always `"qbd_estimate"`.

itemId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the item for this line. (ItemRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

description.description: (Optional) Description for the line item. Max 4000 chars.

unitOfMeasure.description: (Optional) Unit of measure for the quantity. Max 31 chars.

rate.description: (Optional) The rate/price per item. Mutually exclusive with RatePercent, MarkupRate, MarkupRatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PRICETYPE)

ratePercent.description: (Optional) The percentage rate applied. Mutually exclusive with Rate, MarkupRate, MarkupRatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PERCENTTYPE)

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with this line item. (ClassRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

amount.description: (Optional) The total amount for the line item. Required if Rate/RatePercent is not specified. (AMTTYPE)

optionForPriceRuleConflict.description: (Optional) How QuickBooks should handle a price rule conflict. Valid values: Zero, BasePrice.

inventorySiteId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site. (InventorySiteRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

inventorySiteLocationId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site Location. (InventorySiteLocationRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

salesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Sales Tax Code. (SalesTaxCodeRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

markupRate.description: (Optional) A fixed markup rate. Mutually exclusive with MarkupRatePercent, Rate/RatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PRICETYPE)

markupRatePercent.description: (Optional) A percentage markup rate. Mutually exclusive with MarkupRate, Rate/RatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PERCENTTYPE)

priceLevelId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Price Level. Mutually exclusive with Markup fields and Rate fields. (PriceLevelRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

overrideItemAccountId.description: (Optional, Add only) The ListID or FullName of the overriding Item Account. (OverrideItemAccountRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

customFields.description: (Optional, Add only) List of custom data extensions.

CreateEstimateRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new Estimate in QuickBooks.
Based on the EstimateAdd QBXML type.

customerId.description: (Required) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job. (CustomerRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with the entire transaction. (ClassRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

templateId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the template to use for the Estimate. (TemplateRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction. Defaults to today. (DATETYPE)

refNumber.description: (Optional) The sequential reference number for the Estimate (e.g., Estimate Number). (STRTYPE)

isActive.description: (Optional) Whether the Estimate is active. (BOOLTYPE)

termsId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the payment terms for the Estimate. (TermsRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

dueDate.description: (Optional) The due date calculated from the terms. (DATETYPE)

salesRepId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Sales Rep. (SalesRepRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

itemSalesTaxId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales tax item that applies to the entire Estimate. (ItemSalesTaxRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

memo.description: (Optional) A memo for the entire transaction. (STRTYPE)

customerMessageId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Customer Message to appear on the form. (CustomerMsgRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

isQueuedForEmailed.description: (Optional) Whether the Estimate should be flagged to be emailed. (BOOLTYPE)

isTaxIncluded.description: (Optional) Whether tax is included in the line item amounts. (BOOLTYPE)

customerSalesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Customer Sales Tax Code. (CustomerSalesTaxCodeRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

other.description: (Optional) The Other field for the transaction. (STRTYPE)

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) The exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. (FLOATTYPE)

lineItems.description: (Optional) List of standard Estimate lines (EstimateLineAdd). Mutually exclusive with LineItemGroups.

lineItemGroups.description: (Optional) List of item group lines (EstimateLineGroupAdd). Mutually exclusive with LineItems.

externalId.description: (Optional) A unique identifier assigned by the client application for tracking the asynchronous request. (GUIDTYPE, from ICreateRequest)

dataExt.description: (Optional) List of custom fields (DataExt) for the Estimate. (DataExtRequest)

CreateExpenseLineRequest.description:
Expense Line to a transaction.
Based on the ExpenseLineAdd QBXML type.

accountId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the expense account.

amount.description: (Optional) The amount of the expense line.

memo.description: (Optional) A memo specific to this line item.

customerId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job.

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class.

vendorId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the vendor.

salesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales tax code.

salesRepresentativeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales rep.

customFields.description: (Optional) List of custom data extensions.

CreateInventoryAdjustmentLineRequest.description:
Represents a single line item for an Inventory Adjustment operation.
Only ONE of the adjustment properties (Quantity, Value, SerialNumber, LotNumber) should be populated.

CreateInventoryAdjustmentRequest.description:
A request model for adding a new Inventory Adjustment transaction.
Corresponds to the InventoryAdjustmentAdd QBXML message.

*Creates an inventory adjustment to correct on-hand quantities or values. QuickBooks requires 
single-user mode unless you’re on Enterprise with Advanced Inventory enabled.

accountId.description:
(Required) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Adjustment account (usually Inventory Adjustment or an expense account).
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for AccountRef.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction. Defaults to today.

refNumber.description: (Optional) The document number. (Max 11 characters)

inventorySiteId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site where the adjustment occurs.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for InventorySiteRef.

customerId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job related to the adjustment (Job Costing).
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for CustomerRef.

classId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with the transaction header.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for ClassRef.

memo.description: (Optional) General memo about the Inventory Adjustment. (Max 4095 characters)

inventoryAdjustmentLines.description: (Required) A list of line items specifying the quantities/values being adjusted.

externalId.description:
(Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.
Implemented from ICreateRequest.

CreateInventoryItemRequest.description:
Request for creating a new inventory item.
Implements ICreateRequest for the abstraction pattern.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this inventory item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two inventory items could both have the `name` "Cabinet", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Kitchen:Cabinet" and "Inventory:Cabinet".

barcode.description: The barcode associated with this inventory item.

classId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the Class linked to this inventory item.

parentId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the parent inventory item, if this is a sub-item.

sku.description:
The manufacturer part number for the inventory item.

Stored as SKU in the database layer.

unitOfMeasureSetId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the unit of measure set associated with this inventory item.

isTaxIncluded.description: Indicates whether sales tax is included in the sales price.

salesTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the sales tax code associated with this inventory item.

salesDescription.description: Customer-facing description printed on sales documents like invoices and sales receipts.

salesPrice.description: The price at which this inventory item is sold to customers, represented as a decimal string.

incomeAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the income account used to track revenue from sales of this inventory item.

purchaseDescription.description: Vendor-facing description printed on purchase forms like purchase orders or bills.

purchaseCost.description: The cost at which this inventory item is purchased from vendors, represented as a decimal string.

purchaseTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the purchase tax code.

cogsAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) account.

preferredVendorId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the preferred vendor from whom this inventory item is typically purchased.

assetAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the asset account used to track the current value of this inventory item in inventory.

reorderPoint.description: The minimum quantity of this inventory item at which QuickBooks prompts for reordering.

maximumQuantityOnHand.description: The maximum quantity of this inventory item to hold in inventory.

quantityOnHand.description: The number of units of this inventory item currently in inventory. `quantityOnHand` multiplied by `averageCost` equals `totalValue` for inventory item lists. To change the `quantityOnHand` for an inventory item, you must use an inventory-adjustment instead of updating the inventory item directly.

totalValue.description: The total asset value of this inventory item.

inventoryDate.description: The date when this inventory quantity on hand was recorded.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

externalId.description:
Fulfills the ICreateRequest interface.
Used for tracking the "Add" job.

A custom external reference identifier applied to map this record with a secondary software workflow or tracking engine. Must be GUID format to ensure uniqueness and prevent collisions.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this inventory site, unique across all inventory sites.

**NOTE**: Inventory sites do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory site is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

description.description: A description of this inventory site.

contact.description: The name of the primary contact person for this inventory site.

phone.description: The inventory site's primary telephone number.

CreateInvoiceRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new invoice in QuickBooks.
Matches InvoiceAddRq in QBXML.

customerId.description: Customer ListID (required).

transactionDate.description: Transaction date (defaults to today if not specified).

classId.description: Class ListID.

refNumber.description: Reference number for the invoice.

isPending.description: Indicates whether this invoice has not been completed or is in a draft version.

isFinanceCharge.description: Whether this invoice includes a finance charge. This field is immutable and can only be set during invoice creation.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The PoNumber associated with this object.

dueDate.description: Due date for the invoice.

shipmentOrigin.description: The Fob associated with this object.

shippingDate.description: The ShipDate associated with this object.

memo.description: Memo/description for the invoice.

isQueuedForPrint.description: The IsToBePrinted associated with this object.

isQueuedForEmail.description: The IsToBeEmailed associated with this object.

isTaxIncluded.description: The isTaxIncluded associated with this object.

otherCustomField.description: The Other associated with this object.

exchangeRate.description: The market exchange rate between this invoice's currency and the home currency in QuickBooks at the time of this transaction. Represented as a decimal value (e.g., 1.2345 for 1 EUR = 1.2345 USD if USD is the home currency).

externalId.description: An optional, client-provided GUID for external tracking.

applyCredits.description: Specific credit transactions to apply while creating the invoice.

lines.description: Item line items for the invoice.

lineGroups.description: Item group line items for the invoice.

CreateItemDiscountRequest.description: Request model for creating an ItemDiscount.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this discount item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two discount items could both have the `name` "10% labor discount", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Discounts:10% labor discount" and "Promotions:10% labor discount".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this discount item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

parentId.description:
The unique QuickBooks ListID of the parent discount item, if this is a sub-item.

Only applicable if this is a sub-item and hierarchy is enabled.

parentName.description: The fully qualified name of the parent discount item, if this is a sub-item.

itemDesc.description:
The customer-facing description printed on sales documents when applying this discount item.

Optional. If omitted, QuickBooks will use the default description set on the item itself.

salesTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the default sales tax code applied to this discount item.

salesTaxCodeName.description: The name of the default sales tax code applied to this discount item.

discountRate.description:
The monetary amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction, represented as a decimal string.

**NOTE**: A flat rate discount applies to ALL lines recorded above it and distributes the discount amount equally across those lines, which affects tax calculations. For example, a $10 discount applied to a $100 taxable item and $100 non-taxable item would result in a $5 taxable discount and $5 non-taxable discount.

discountRatePercent.description:
The percentage amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction.

**NOTE**: A percentage discount only applies to the line immediately above it, so tax implications only affect that specific line.

accountId.description:
The unique QuickBooks ListID of the posting account to which transactions involving this discount item are posted.

Must be an Expense or Income account.

accountName.description: The name of the posting account to which transactions involving this discount item are posted.

externalId.description:
A custom external reference identifier applied to map this record with a secondary software workflow or tracking engine.

Must be GUID format to ensure uniqueness and prevent collisions.

CreateItemFixedAssetRequest.description: Request model for creating an ItemFixedAsset.

name.description:
The name of the fixed asset item.
Max Length: 31 characters.

Must be unique among sibling items within the same hierarchy level. Case-insensitive.

isActive.description:
Whether the fixed asset item is active.

Inactive items are hidden in QuickBooks lists but preserved in historic data.

classId.description:
Reference to the Class.

Classes can be used to categorize objects into meaningful segments like departments or product lines.

acquiredAs.description:
Indicates the condition of the asset at the time of acquisition (e.g., "New" or "Used").

Helps track asset history and initial valuation constraints.

purchaseDescription.description:
A description of the asset specifically related to its purchase.

Stamped on procurement forms and purchase documentation.
purchaseDescription.example: Purchased from local dealership for logistics team

purchaseDate.description:
The date on which the business purchased or acquired the asset.

Tracks the acquisition calendar date.

purchaseCost.description:
The original purchase price or cost of acquiring the asset.

Represents the core asset cost.

vendorOrPayeeName.description:
The name of the vendor or payee from whom the asset was purchased.

Useful for warranty claims and supplier referencing.

assetAccountId.description:
The identifier of the specific Fixed Asset account in the Chart of Accounts used to track this asset's financial value.

Must reference an account of type FixedAsset.

salesDescription.description:
A description of the sales transaction or the reason for the asset's disposal.

Documenting the reason or parameters of the disposal.

salesPrice.description:
The final price for which the asset was sold.

The gross sale amount realized.

incomeAccountId.description:
The identifier of the asset's posting income account.

The general ledger revenue tracking account.

salesTaxCodeId.description:
The identifier of the sales tax code.

Mapped sales tax code identifying if this item is taxable.

assetDescription.description:
A general description of the fixed asset.

Main asset reference label.

location.description:
The physical location or department where the asset is currently kept.

Identifies geography or cost center.

purchaseOrderNumber.description:
The Purchase Order number associated with the acquisition of the asset.

Links the asset back to purchase history.

serialNumber.description:
The serial number or vehicle identification number (VIN) of the asset.

Unique hardware identification tag.

warrantyExpirationDate.description:
The date on which the manufacturer's or vendor's warranty for the asset expires.

Helps track active warranty timelines.

notes.description:
Additional free-form notes or comments regarding the asset.

Any miscellaneous asset-related observations.
notes.example: Minor scratch on passenger side door from 2020.

assetNumber.description:
A unique, company-assigned tracking number or barcode number for the asset.

Internal asset tracking code.

costBasis.description:
The cost basis of the asset used for calculating tax and depreciation.

Often includes purchase price plus freight, installation, etc.

yearEndAccumulatedDepreciation.description:
The total amount of depreciation accumulated for this asset up to the end of the most recent fiscal year.

Accumulated depreciation value.

yearEndBookValue.description:
The net book value of the asset at the end of the fiscal year.

Typically Cost Basis minus Accumulated Depreciation.

externalid.description:
External GUID for the fixed asset item.

A custom external reference identifier applied to map this record with a secondary software workflow or tracking engine. Must be GUID format to ensure uniqueness and prevent collisions.

CreateItemGroupLineRequest.description:
A reusable request DTO for adding an Item Group Line to a transaction.
Based on the ItemGroupLineAdd QBXML type.

itemGroupId.description: (Required) The ListID or FullName of the item group.

quantity.description: (Optional) Quantity of the group. QuickBooks will multiply this by the group's internal quantities.

unitOfMeasure.description: (Optional) Unit of measure.

inventorySiteId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the inventory site.

inventorySiteLocationId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the inventory site location.

customFields.description: (Optional) List of custom data extensions.

CreateItemGroupRequest.description:
Request for creating a new item group.
Implements ICreateRequest for the new abstraction.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this item group, unique across all item groups.

**NOTE**: Item groups do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

barCode.description:
The barcode request object linking barcode properties.

Optional barcode configuration.

description.description:
A general description of the item group.

Primary reference description.
description.example: A custom group of standard services

isActive.description:
Indicates whether this item group is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

Inactive objects are hidden in list views.

unitOfMeasureSetId.description:
Reference to the Unit of Measure Set associated with this group.

Links the group to its available units.

shouldPrintItemsInGroup.description:
Indicates whether the individual items within the group should be printed on transactions.

If true, component items are printed. If false, only the group header is printed.

lines.description:
The list of member items that comprise this group, along with their quantities and units.

Define the constituent items.

externalId.description:
Fulfills the ICreateRequest interface.
Used for tracking the "Add" job.

A custom external reference identifier applied to map this record with a secondary software workflow or tracking engine. Must be GUID format to ensure uniqueness and prevent collisions.

CreateItemInventoryAssemblyRequest.description: Request model for creating an ItemInventoryAssembly.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this inventory assembly item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two inventory assembly items could both have the `name` "Deluxe Kit", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Assemblies:Deluxe Kit" and "Inventory:Deluxe Kit".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory assembly item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

salesPrice.description: The price at which this inventory assembly item is sold to customers, represented as a decimal string.

**IMPORTANT**: A non-inventory item will have either `salesAndPurchaseDetails` or `salesOrPurchaseDetails`, but never both because an item cannot have both configurations.

salesAndPurchaseDetails.description:

**IMPORTANT**: A non-inventory item will have either `salesAndPurchaseDetails` or `salesOrPurchaseDetails`, but never both because an item cannot have both configurations.

salesAndPurchaseDetails.description:

dataExt.description: A series of unique user-defined field records mapping additional metadata properties onto the core structure.

salesOrPurchase.description:
Single-sided details mapping operational rules when this record is exclusively purchased or exclusively sold.

This property is mutually exclusive with <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Items.ServiceItem.Models.CreateServiceItemRequest.SalesAndPurchase" />.

salesAndPurchase.description:
Double-sided data matrix specifying independent client rates and vendor costs for flexible fulfillment models.

This property is mutually exclusive with <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Items.ServiceItem.Models.CreateServiceItemRequest.SalesOrPurchase" />.

CreateSetCreditRequest.description:
Represents the SetCredit aggregate in QBXML.
Used within AppliedToTxnAdd to apply specific credit memos or other credits.

creditTransactionId.description:
The TxnID of the credit transaction (e.g., Credit Memo) to apply.
(Required)

appliedAmount.description:
The amount of the credit to apply.
(Required)

override.description:
If true, overrides default logic for applying credits.
(Optional)

CreateShipMethodRequest.description:
A request model for creating a new Shipping Method.
Corresponds to the ShipMethodAdd QBXML message.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this shipping method, unique across all shipping methods.

**NOTE**: Shipping methods do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this shipping method is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

externalId.description: A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

CreateSpecialItemRequest.description:
Request model for adding a special item (Finance Charge, Reimbursable Subtotal/Group).
Corresponds to the SpecialItemAdd QBXML message.

NOTE: SpecialItem is a CREATE-ONLY resource in QuickBooks.
- SpecialItemAddRq is supported
- SpecialItemModRq does NOT exist (updates not supported)
- SpecialItemQueryRq does NOT exist directly (query via ItemQuery with filters)

QBXML Schema Constraints:
- SpecialItemType: Required, ENUMTYPE (FinanceCharge, ReimbursableExpenseGroup, ReimbursableExpenseSubtotal)
- BarCode: Optional complex type
- ExternalGUID: Optional

specialItemType.description:
(Required) The type of special item to create.
Valid values: "FinanceCharge", "ReimbursableExpenseGroup", "ReimbursableExpenseSubtotal"

barCode.description: (Optional) Bar Code details for the special item.

externalId.description: (Optional) External GUID for tracking/deduplication.

CreateTermRequest.description:
Placeholder request model for creating Terms.
NOTE: Terms is a READ-ONLY resource in QuickBooks - Create operations are NOT supported.
This model exists only for interface compatibility. The validator will reject all requests.

externalId.description: External GUID (not used - Terms cannot be created).

CreateTimeTrackingRequest.description:
A request model for adding a new Time Tracking transaction.
Corresponds to the TimeTrackingAdd QBXML message.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date the work was performed. Defaults to today.

entityId.description: (Required) The ListID or FullName of the Entity (Employee, Vendor, or OtherName) that performed the work.

customerId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job this time is for. Required if IsBillable is true.

itemServiceId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Service Item used to charge for the work.

duration.description: (Required) The duration of the work performed, formatted as an XML TimeIntervalType string (e.g., "PT8H0M0S" for 8 hours).

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with this time entry.

payrollItemWageId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Payroll Item Wage used to process payroll for this time.

notes.description: (Optional) General notes about the time entry. Max 4095 chars.

billableStatus.description: (Optional) Status indicating if the time is billable (Billable, NotBillable, HasBeenBilled).

isBillable.description: (Optional) Legacy flag to set time as billable. Use BillableStatus instead if possible.

externalId.description: (Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

CreateUnitOfMeasureSetRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new Unit Of Measure Set in QuickBooks.
Maps to the QBXML UnitOfMeasureSetAdd request.

QBXML Schema Constraints:
- Name: Required, max length = 31
- IsActive: Optional, defaults to true
- UnitOfMeasureType: Required, ENUMTYPE (Area, Count, Length, Other, Time, Volume, Weight)
- BaseUnit: Required complex type
- RelatedUnit: Optional, may repeat
- DefaultUnit: Optional, may repeat

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this unit-of-measure set, unique across all unit-of-measure sets. To ensure this set appears in the QuickBooks UI for companies configured with a single unit per item, prefix the name with "By the" (e.g., "By the Barrel").

**NOTE**: Unit-of-measure sets do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this unit-of-measure set is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

unitOfMeasureType.description: The unit-of-measure set's type. Use "other" for a custom type defined in QuickBooks.

baseUnit.description: The unit-of-measure set's base unit used to track and price item quantities. If the company file is enabled for a single unit of measure per item, the base unit is the only unit available on transaction line items. If enabled for multiple units per item, the base unit is the default unless overridden by the set's default units.

relatedUnits.description: The unit-of-measure set's related units, each specifying how many base units they represent (conversion ratio).

defaultUnits.description: The unit-of-measure set's default units to appear in the U/M field on transaction line items. You can specify separate defaults for purchases, sales, and shipping.

externalId.description: (Optional) External GUID for tracking/deduplication.

CreateVendorCreditRequest.description:
Represents a request to create a new Vendor Credit.
Based on the VendorCreditAdd QBXML type.

vendorId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the vendor.

payablesAccountId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the A/P account.
Defaults to the standard Accounts Payable account if not specified.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction. Defaults to the current date.

refNumber.description: (Optional) The reference number (e.g., credit memo number from vendor). Max 20 chars.

memo.description: (Optional) A memo for the entire transaction. Max 4095 chars.

isTaxIncluded.description: (Optional) If true, the amount includes sales tax.

salesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales tax code for the transaction.

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) The exchange rate, if using multi-currency.

externalId.description: (Optional) A unique external identifier.

expenseLines.description: (Optional) A list of expense lines to add to the vendor credit.

itemLines.description:
(Optional) A list of item lines to add to the vendor credit.
Note: You can have either ItemLines or ItemGroupLines, but not both.

itemGroupLines.description:
(Optional) A list of item group lines to add to the vendor credit.
Note: You can have either ItemLines or ItemGroupLines, but not both.

CreateVendorRequest.description:
Request for creating a new vendor.
Implements ICreateRequest for the new abstraction.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this vendor, unique across all vendors.

**NOTE**: Vendors do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this vendor is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

companyName.description: The name of the company associated with this vendor. This name is used on invoices, checks, and other forms.

salutation.description: The formal salutation title that precedes the name of the contact person for this vendor, such as "Mr.", "Ms.", or "Dr.".

firstName.description: The first name of the contact person for this vendor.

middleName.description: The middle name of the contact person for this vendor.

lastName.description: The last name of the contact person for this vendor.

jobTitle.description: The job title of the contact person for this vendor.

contact.description: The name of the primary contact person for this vendor.

customContactFields.description: Additional custom contact fields for this vendor, such as phone numbers or email addresses.

additionalContacts.description: Additional alternate contacts for this vendor.

nameOnCheck.description: The vendor's name as it should appear on checks issued to this vendor.

accountNumber.description:
The vendor's account number, which appears in the QuickBooks chart of accounts, reports, and graphs.

Note that if the "Use Account Numbers" preference is turned off in QuickBooks, the account number may not be visible in the user interface, but it can still be set and retrieved through the API.

creditLimit.description: The vendor's credit limit, represented as a decimal string. This is the maximum amount of money that can be spent being before billed by this vendor. If `null`, there is no credit limit.

salesTaxCountry.description: The country for which sales tax is collected for this vendor.

isSalesTaxAgency.description: Indicates whether this vendor is a sales tax agency.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The vendor's tax registration number, for use in Canada or the UK.

reportingPeriod.description: The vendor's tax reporting period, for use in Canada or the UK.

externalId.description:
Fulfills the ICreateRequest interface.
Used for tracking the "Add" job.

CreateVendorTypeRequest.description:
A request model for creating a new Vendor Type.
Corresponds to the VendorTypeAdd QBXML message.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this customer type. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two customer types could both have the `name` "Healthcare", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Industry:Healthcare" and "Region:Healthcare".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this customer type is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

parentId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the parent vendor type. Used for hierarchical vendor types.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for ParentRef.

externalId.description: A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

CreateWorkersCompCodeRequest.description:
Request DTO for adding a new Workers' Compensation Code.
Based on the WorkersCompCodeAdd QBXML type.

QBXML Schema Constraints:
- Name: Required, max length = 13
- IsActive: Optional
- Desc: Optional, max length = 31
- RateEntry: Required (1 or more)

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this employee, unique across all employees. A concatenation of the employee's `firstName`, `middleName`, and `lastName` fields.

**NOTE**: Employees do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this employee is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

desc.description: (Optional) Description of the code. Max length: 31.

rateEntries.description:
(Required) List of rate entries associated with this code.
Must have at least one entry.

externalId.description: A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

CreditCardBillPayment.description: Represents a payment made against one or more vendor bills using a Credit Card.

id.description:
The unique identifier assigned by QuickBooks to this transaction.

This ID is unique across **all** transaction types in the QuickBooks company file,
not just within its own type. This value is assigned by QuickBooks and never changes.

objectType.description: The type of object. This value is dynamically generated to represent the specific QuickBooks entity.

createdAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was originally created in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format. Note that QuickBooks Desktop typically interprets these timestamps
relative to the local timezone of the host computer where the company file resides.

updatedAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was last modified in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format.

revisionNumber.description:
The current QuickBooks-assigned revision number for this object.

This value changes every time the record is modified.
When updating this object, you must provide the most recent `revisionNumber` to ensure you are
working with the latest data and to prevent optimistic concurrency errors.

transactionDate.description: The date the transaction occurred or was recorded.

currency.description:
The currency used for this transaction.

Only applicable if the QuickBooks company file has multi-currency enabled.

exchangeRate.description:
The market exchange rate between the transaction's currency and the home currency.

Only applicable if multi-currency is enabled.

refNumber.description:
A user-defined reference number for this transaction (e.g., check number, invoice number).

This value is case-sensitive and appears in various QuickBooks UI forms.
**Note:** This string is not guaranteed to be unique, even within the same transaction type.

memo.description: A memo or note for the transaction that appears in registers and reports.

payablesAccount.description:
The Accounts Payable (A/P) account associated with the bills being paid.

**Important:** This A/P account must exactly match the `payablesAccount` used on the original vendor bills.
If omitted, QuickBooks Desktop will use its default A/P account.

appliedToTransactions.description: The bill or list of bills that this bill credit card payment is applied to.

amount.description:
The total monetary amount of the transaction.

Typically calculated automatically by QuickBooks based on the sum of the transaction's line items.

entity.description: The primary entity (Customer, Vendor, or Employee) associated with this transaction.

account.description: The bank or credit card account used for this transaction.

amountInHomeCurrency.description: The transaction amount converted into the QuickBooks company file's home currency.

hasValidLineItems.description: Internal validation helper to check if the transaction contains at least one valid line item.

externalId.description:
A globally unique identifier (GUID) provided by your application to track this record in an external system.

This field is immutable and can only be set during the initial creation of the transaction.

linkedTransactions.description:
Other transactions linked to this transaction (e.g., payments applied to an invoice, or purchase orders linked to a bill).

**Important:** QuickBooks does not always return linked transactions by default to optimize performance.
When querying lists of transactions, you may need to explicitly include a parameter (e.g., `includeLinkedTransactions=true`) to populate this array.

expenseLines.description: The General Ledger expense lines associated with this transaction.

itemLines.description: The inventory, service, or non-inventory item lines associated with this transaction.

itemGroupLines.description: Predefined sets of items (Item Groups) bundled together on this transaction.

creditCardAccount.description:
The credit card account used to make this payment.

**Required.** This transaction will increase the liability balance of this credit card account.

customFields.description:
Custom fields and data extensions associated with this entity. Used for tracking user-defined data beyond standard QuickBooks properties.
- **Public Fields:** Viewable and printable in the QuickBooks UI (OwnerID of "0"). Strictly limited to 255-character strings.
- **Private Fields:** Visible only to the application that created them via a specific GUID. Total private data is limited to 4096 bytes per object across all applications.
- **Inheritance:** Transaction objects automatically inherit custom fields from their associated Customer and Item records.

InventoryItem.description:
Inventory are things the QuickBooks company sells, as well as things it buys. QuickBooks Desktop can manage product inventory. Line items entered on sales,
purchase, and refund transactions flow into inventory items to automatically adjust quantity on hand. Additionally, cost and price of individual inventory
items are stored so inventory value can be tracked. After enabling inventory management, add individual inventory items as Item objects.
QuickBooks Supports:
FIFO inventory accounting, Tracking quantity on hand, Categories to four levels, Taxable status of the item, Price and cost

discountRate.description:
The monetary amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction, represented as a decimal string.

**NOTE**: A flat rate discount applies to ALL lines recorded above it and distributes the discount amount equally across those lines, which affects tax calculations. For example, a $10 discount applied to a $100 taxable item and $100 non-taxable item would result in a $5 taxable discount and $5 non-taxable discount.

discountRatePercent.description:
The percentage amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction.

**NOTE**: A percentage discount only applies to the line immediately above it, so tax implications only affect that specific line.

ItemInventoryItem.description:
Inventory are things the QuickBooks company sells, as well as things it buys. QuickBooks Desktop can manage product inventory. Line items entered on sales,
purchase, and refund transactions flow into inventory items to automatically adjust quantity on hand. Additionally, cost and price of individual inventory
items are stored so inventory value can be tracked. After enabling inventory management, add individual inventory items as Item objects.
QuickBooks Supports:
FIFO inventory accounting, Tracking quantity on hand, Categories to four levels, Taxable status of the item, Price and cost

ItemItemSalesTaxGroup.description:
Sales-tax group item, is an item used for calculating two or more sales taxes grouped
together and applied to the same sale.

For example, local and state taxes could be tracked
separately but applied to a sale as one tax. (Compare with the ItemSalesTaxAdd message.) Taxes
can be reflected in transaction line items The following information refers to invoices
specifically, but it also applies to sales receipts. Generally its best to assign a tax item
or tax group item to an invoice and allow QuickBooks to apply the same tax to all taxable
items on the invoice. However in some situations multiple tax combinations are required, so
this method doesn’t work. In this case one must use techniques to apply the taxes in the
invoice itself as line items.

item.description: The item associated with this item line. This can refer to any good or service that the business buys or sells, including item types such as a service item, inventory item, or special calculation item like a discount item or sales-tax item.

description.description: A description of this item line.

quantity.description:

**NOTE**: Do not use this field if the associated item is a discount item.

cost.description: The cost of this item line, represented as a decimal string. If both `quantity` and `amount` are specified but not `cost`, QuickBooks will use them to calculate `cost`.

amount.description: The monetary amount of this item line, represented as a decimal string. If both `quantity` and `cost` are specified but not `amount`, QuickBooks will use them to calculate `amount`. If `amount`, `cost`, and `quantity` are all unspecified, then QuickBooks will calculate `amount` based on a `quantity` of `1` and the suggested `cost`. This field cannot be cleared.

ItemNonInventory.description: Materials or parts for which you do not track quantities. Materials or parts you buy but do not sell, or materials or parts you sell but do not buy, are non-inventory items. For example, if you sell a service that requires a part, but you do not want to track the part as an inventory item, you can set up the part as a non-inventory item. You can also use non-inventory items for one-time purchases or sales of items that you do not want to track at all. Non-inventory items are used on sales forms and purchase forms, and they affect your financial statements.

ItemReceipt.description:
Represents an Item Receipt transaction DTO.
This inherits TxnID, RefNumber, TxnDate, Amount (from TotalAmount), 
Entity (from VendorRef), Memo, ExchangeRate, AmountInHomeCurrency,
ExternalGuid, and all line item lists from BaseTransactionDto.
An item receipt records the physical receipt of inventory items from a vendor. It can be linked 
to a purchase order to automatically update inventory quantities and close out the purchase order. 
When linked, line items are automatically pulled from the purchase order, eliminating the need to 
recreate them manually. This linking can only be done during item receipt creation, 
not during modification.

ItemSalesTaxGroup.description:
Sales-tax group item, is an item used for calculating two or more sales taxes grouped
together and applied to the same sale.

For example, local and state taxes could be tracked
separately but applied to a sale as one tax. (Compare with the ItemSalesTaxAdd message.) Taxes
can be reflected in transaction line items The following information refers to invoices
specifically, but it also applies to sales receipts. Generally its best to assign a tax item
or tax group item to an invoice and allow QuickBooks to apply the same tax to all taxable
items on the invoice. However in some situations multiple tax combinations are required, so
this method doesn’t work. In this case one must use techniques to apply the taxes in the
invoice itself as line items.

The fixed percentage adjustment applied to all items for this price level (instead of a per-item price level). Once you create the price level, you cannot change this.

When this price level is applied to a customer, it automatically adjusts the `rate` and `amount` columns for applicable line items in sales orders and invoices for that customer. Report.description:
Generic QuickBooks Report object (e.g., Aging, Custom).
A report is a method for obtaining a comprehensive view of data across multiple objects and over a specified time period, as opposed to a query, which typically just provides a simple snapshot of specific objects.
 Reports are capable of spanning multiple data types and can be customized in a wide variety of ways.
 When QuickBooks returns a report response, it generally contains two main types of information:
 Report Meta-data: This information describes the report as a whole.
 It includes the report's title and subtitle, the report basis (such as Cash, Accrual, or None), the total number of rows and columns, the number of rows used for column titles, and a column descriptor for each column that outlines its ID, title, column type, and data type.
 Report Data: This is the actual content, presented as sequential rows of data expressed in name/value pairs.
 These rows are further categorized into four types: text rows (mainly used for headings), data rows(the core report data), subtotal rows(calculated subtotals), and a single total row(the calculated total for the entire report).

This ID is unique across **all** transaction types in the QuickBooks company file,
not just within its own type. This value is assigned by QuickBooks and never changes.

objectType.description: The type of object. This value is dynamically generated to represent the specific QuickBooks entity.

createdAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was originally created in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format. Note that QuickBooks Desktop typically interprets these timestamps
relative to the local timezone of the host computer where the company file resides.

updatedAt.description:
The date and time when this entity was last modified in QuickBooks.

Represented in ISO 8601 format.

revisionNumber.description:
The current QuickBooks-assigned revision number for this object.

This value changes every time the record is modified.
When updating this object, you must provide the most recent `revisionNumber` to ensure you are
working with the latest data and to prevent optimistic concurrency errors.

transactionDate.description: The date the transaction occurred or was recorded.

currency.description:
The currency used for this transaction.

Only applicable if the QuickBooks company file has multi-currency enabled.

exchangeRate.description:
The market exchange rate between the transaction's currency and the home currency.

Only applicable if multi-currency is enabled.

refNumber.description:
A user-defined reference number for this transaction (e.g., check number, invoice number).

This value is case-sensitive and appears in various QuickBooks UI forms.
**Note:** This string is not guaranteed to be unique, even within the same transaction type.

memo.description: A memo or note for the transaction that appears in registers and reports.

transactionNumber.description: The TxnNumber associated with this object.

customer.description: The customer associated with this object.

itemService.description: The itemService associated with this object.

duration.description: (Required) The duration of the work performed, formatted as an XML TimeIntervalType string (e.g., "PT8H0M0S" for 8 hours).

class.description: The class associated with this object.

payrollItemWage.description: The payrollItemWage associated with this object.

notes.description: (Optional) General notes about the time entry. Max 4095 chars.

billableStatus.description: (Optional) Status indicating if the time is billable (Billable, NotBillable, HasBeenBilled).

isBillable.description: (Optional) Legacy flag to set time as billable. Use BillableStatus instead if possible.

isBilled.description: The isBilled associated with this object.

amount.description:
The total monetary amount of the transaction.

Typically calculated automatically by QuickBooks based on the sum of the transaction's line items.

entity.description: The primary entity (Customer, Vendor, or Employee) associated with this transaction.

account.description: The bank or credit card account used for this transaction.

amountInHomeCurrency.description: The transaction amount converted into the QuickBooks company file's home currency.

hasValidLineItems.description: Internal validation helper to check if the transaction contains at least one valid line item.

externalId.description:
A globally unique identifier (GUID) provided by your application to track this record in an external system.

This field is immutable and can only be set during the initial creation of the transaction.

linkedTransactions.description:
Other transactions linked to this transaction (e.g., payments applied to an invoice, or purchase orders linked to a bill).

**Important:** QuickBooks does not always return linked transactions by default to optimize performance.
When querying lists of transactions, you may need to explicitly include a parameter (e.g., `includeLinkedTransactions=true`) to populate this array.

expenseLines.description: The General Ledger expense lines associated with this transaction.

itemLines.description: The inventory, service, or non-inventory item lines associated with this transaction.

itemGroupLines.description: Predefined sets of items (Item Groups) bundled together on this transaction.

customFields.description:
Custom fields and data extensions associated with this entity. Used for tracking user-defined data beyond standard QuickBooks properties.
- **Public Fields:** Viewable and printable in the QuickBooks UI (OwnerID of "0"). Strictly limited to 255-character strings.
- **Private Fields:** Visible only to the application that created them via a specific GUID. Total private data is limited to 4096 bytes per object across all applications.
- **Inheritance:** Transaction objects automatically inherit custom fields from their associated Customer and Item records.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Contains parameters to modify an existing financial account.

revisionNumber.description:
The current revision number of the object, used for optimistic concurrency.

Provide the most recent revision number to ensure you're working with the latest data; otherwise, the update will fail.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this account.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this account is active.

accountType.description: The classification of this account, indicating its purpose within the chart of accounts.

isTaxAccount.description: Indicates whether this account is used for tracking taxes.

accountNumber.description: The account number, which appears in the chart of accounts, reports, and graphs.

description.description: A description of this account.
description.example: "Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services purchased on credit."

parentId.description: The parent account one level above this one in the hierarchy.

salesTaxCodeId.description:
The default sales-tax code for transactions with this account.

Determines whether the transactions are taxable or non-taxable. This can be overridden at the transaction or transaction-line level.

openBalance.description: The amount of money in, or the value of, this account as of the opening balance date.

openBalanceDate.description: The date of the opening balance of this account.

taxLineId.description: The identifier of the tax line associated with this account.

bankNumber.description: The bank account number or identifying note.

revisionNumber.description: (Required) The EditSequence of the transaction being modified (for concurrency control).

customerId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer receiving the refund.

refundFromAccountId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the account the refund is coming from.

receivablesAccountId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the A/R account involved.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction.

refNumber.description: (Optional) The reference number for the refund.

paymentMethodId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the payment method.

memo.description: (Optional) A memo for the transaction.

creditCardTransaction.description: (Optional) Information about the credit card transaction if processed outside QuickBooks.

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) The exchange rate for the transaction.

refundAppliedToTransactions.description: (Optional) List of credit transactions (e.g., Credit Memos) to apply this refund to.

UpdateBillPaymentOrCreditRequest.description: BillToPay is a read-only query result in QuickBooks and cannot be modified directly.

revisionNumber.description:
The concurrency identifier for the record.

Maps to QuickBooks `EditSequence`. This value changes every time the record is modified.
If the value provided doesn't match the current value in QB, the update will fail.

vendorId.description:
The unique identifier of the vendor associated with this bill.

**Important:** If this bill is linked to other transactions, this vendor's A/P account must match the account used in those transactions.

vendorAddress.description: An optional override for the vendor's billing address.

payablesAccountId.description:
The Accounts Payable (A/P) account used to track the amount owed.

If omitted, QuickBooks will use its default A/P account.

transactionDate.description: The transaction date of the bill.

dueDate.description: The date by which the bill must be paid.

refNumber.description:
A user-defined reference number for the bill. Case-sensitive.

Set to an empty string (`""`) to clear the existing reference number in QuickBooks.

termsId.description: The payment terms defining when the bill is due and applicable discounts.

classId.description: Reference to the QuickBooks Class for categorization (e.g., department, location).

memo.description:
A note that appears in the A/P register and related reports.

Set to an empty string (`""`) to clear the existing memo in QuickBooks.

isTaxIncluded.description: Whether tax is included in item amounts.

exchangeRate.description: The market exchange rate between the bill's currency and the home currency.

clearExpenseLines.description:
When `true`, forcefully removes all existing expense lines from the bill.

To selectively modify or add lines instead of wiping them, use the `ExpenseLines` array.

expenseLines.description:
Expense line items to modify or add. **Array Replacement Rules:** Providing this array will **REPLACE** all existing expense lines.
- **Update / Retain:** To keep or modify an existing line, include it with its current `Id`. **Any existing lines not included in this array will be removed.**
- **Add:** To append a new line to the bill, include it with an `Id` set to `"-1"`.
- **Ignore:** Omit this property entirely (send `null`) to leave existing expense lines completely unchanged.
- **Delete All:** To remove all expense lines, leave this `null` and set `ClearExpenseLines` to `true` instead.

clearItemLines.description:
When `true`, forcefully removes all existing item lines from the bill.

To selectively modify or add lines instead of wiping them, use the `ItemLines` array.

itemLines.description:
Inventory or service item allocations to modify or add. **Array Replacement Rules:** Providing this array will **REPLACE** all existing item lines.
- **Update / Retain:** To keep or modify an existing line, include it with its current `Id`. **Any existing lines not included in this array will be removed.**
- **Add:** To append a new line to the bill, include it with an `Id` set to `"-1"`.
- **Ignore:** Omit this property entirely (send `null`) to leave existing item lines completely unchanged.
- **Delete All:** To remove all item lines, leave this `null` and set `ClearItemLines` to `true` instead.

Main request model to update an existing Credit Card Charge.

itemGroupLines.description:
