Emitted as `DataExtModRq`. To clear a value entirely, use
DeleteCustomFieldValueRequest instead — sending an empty value here is rejected.

ownerId.description: The owner identifier of the custom field definition (`"0"` for public).

name.description: The name of the custom field to modify.

value.description:
The new value to assign. Public fields support 255 characters; private
STR1024TYPE definitions support up to 1024.

target.description: The composite target identifying which QBD object owns the value.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Represents a request to modify an existing customer or project (job) in QuickBooks Desktop.

revisionNumber.description:
The current revision number assigned by QuickBooks to this customer record.

**Required for updates.** This ensures optimistic concurrency. You must provide the most recent revision number obtained from a prior GET request. If the record has been modified in QuickBooks since you last fetched it, this update request will be rejected to prevent data loss.

name.description:
The primary identifier name for the customer or job.

This value is case-insensitive. Modifying this will automatically change the customer's fully-qualified name across QuickBooks.

companyName.description: The formal company name printed on invoices, checks, and official correspondence.

suffix.description: A name suffix for the primary contact (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

printAs.description: The exact text format that should be printed on physical checks.

pager.description: The pager number for the primary contact.

mobile.description: The mobile/cellular telephone number for the primary contact.

isActive.description: Determines whether this customer record is active and visible in standard QuickBooks lists and reports.

parentId.description:
The unique identifier of the hierarchical parent customer.

**Important:** This field is required if you are actively updating or setting the <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.JobStatus" />, as that indicates this record is a sub-customer (job).

classId.description: The unique identifier of the Class associated with this customer, used for segmentation.

customerTypeId.description: The unique identifier of the Customer Type, used to group customers for specialized reporting.

termsId.description: The unique identifier dictating the payment schedule and early-payment discounts (e.g., Net 30).

salesRepresentativeId.description: The unique identifier of the assigned sales agent, vendor, or employee managing this account.

salesTaxItemId.description: The identifier for the specific tax agency rate applied to this customer's purchases.

preferredPaymentMethodId.description: The identifier for the customer's default payment method (e.g., Cash, Check, Visa).

priceLevelId.description: The identifier for a custom pricing tier applied automatically to items sold to this customer.

taxRegistrationNumber.description: The official tax identification number (primarily utilized in UK and Canadian QBD versions).

jobTypeId.description: The unique identifier categorizing the nature of the job (e.g., Commercial, Residential, Maintenance).

currencyId.description:
The unique identifier of the default currency used for this customer's transactions.

QuickBooks must have multicurrency support enabled.

creditCardInfo.description: Stored credit card details for processing transactions.

salutation.description: The formal title preceding the primary contact's name (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.).

firstName.description: The first name of the primary contact person.

middleName.description: The middle name or initial of the primary contact person.

lastName.description: The last name of the primary contact person.

jobTitle.description: The professional title of the primary contact.

billingAddress.description: The default billing location for invoices and statements.

shippingAddress.description: The default shipping location for products.

shipToAddresses.description:
A collection of secondary shipping locations.

**Note:** Updating ship-to addresses replaces the entire existing list in QuickBooks.

email.description: The primary email address used for digital correspondence and e-invoicing.

ccEmail.description: An additional email address to automatically CC on communications.

contact.description: The full name of the primary contact individual.

alternateContact.description: The full name of a secondary or emergency contact individual.

customContactFields.description: User-defined contact data points (e.g., Skype ID, secondary emails).

creditLimit.description: The maximum allowable outstanding balance before a credit hold is triggered.

jobStatus.description:
The current operational state of the job.

**Important:** Modifying this explicitly requires <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.ParentId" /> to be populated, indicating this is a sub-customer/job entity.

jobStartDate.description:
The date active work commenced on the job.

Must be chronologically before or equal to <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.JobProjectedEndDate" /> and <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.JobEndDate" />, if they are provided.

jobProjectedEndDate.description:
The estimated deadline for job completion.

Must be chronologically on or after the <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.JobStartDate" />, if provided.

jobEndDate.description:
The actual date the job was finalized.

Must be chronologically on or after the <see cref="P:QbdWebService.Application.Resources.Qbd.Lists.Customer.Models.UpdateCustomerRequest.JobStartDate" />, if provided.

jobDesc.description: A short summary outlining the scope of work for the job.

notes.description: An overarching internal comment or memo regarding the customer.

additionalNotes.description: A collection of modifications to individual, distinct internal notes attached to the customer record.

preferredDeliveryMethod.description: The default medium for sending invoices and estimates.

resaleNumber.description: The certificate number provided by customers purchasing items wholesale/for resale.

accountNumber.description: A custom internal tracking number that appears on the Chart of Accounts and reports.

fax.description: The facsimile number for the customer.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this customer type. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two customer types could both have the `name` "Healthcare", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Industry:Healthcare" and "Region:Healthcare".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this customer type is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

UpdateDateDrivenTermRequest.description:
Placeholder request model for updating Terms.
NOTE: Terms is a READ-ONLY resource in QuickBooks - Update operations are NOT supported.
This model exists only for interface compatibility. The validator will reject all requests.

revisionNumber.description: The EditSequence (not used - Terms cannot be modified).

UpdateDepositLineRequest.description: Defines a single Deposit Line item to be modified on the Deposit (uses discriminator pattern and TxnLineId).

transactionLineId.description: (Required) The unique ID for this line item within the transaction.

paymentLineMod.description:
(Optional) Modification details for a payment line (PaymentTxnID, OverrideMemo, etc.).
Mutually exclusive with ManualLineMod.

manualLineMod.description:
(Optional) Modification details for a manual line (EntityId, AccountId, Amount, etc.).
Mutually exclusive with PaymentLineMod.

UpdateDepositRequest.description:
A request model for modifying an existing Deposit transaction.
Corresponds to the DepositMod QBXML message.

revisionNumber.description:
(Required) The EditSequence is a sequence number value assigned to an object that is used for concurrency control. (Max 16 characters)
Implemented from IUpdateRequest.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The new date of the transaction.

depositToAccountId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the bank account where the funds are deposited.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for DepositToAccountRef.

memo.description: (Optional) New general memo about the Deposit. (Max 4095 characters)

cashBackInfo.description: (Optional) Modification to the cash back information.

currencyId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the currency for the transaction.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for CurrencyRef.

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) New exchange rate if this is a foreign currency Deposit.

depositLines.description: (Optional) A list of modifications for the existing Deposit lines.

externalId.description: (Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.description: Request model for updating an existing employee.

revisionNumber.description: Required for QuickBooks "Mod" operations for optimistic concurrency.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this employee is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

salutation.description: The employee's formal salutation title that precedes their name, such as "Mr.", "Ms.", or "Dr.".

department.description: The employee's department. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

description.description: A description of this employee. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

printAs.description: The name to use when printing this employee from QuickBooks. By default, this is the same as the `name` field.

ssn.description:
The employee's Social Security Number. The value can be with or without dashes.

**NOTE**: This field cannot be changed after the employee is created.

emergencyContacts.description: Emergency contacts for the employee (QBD only, v13.0+).

employeeType.description: The employee type. This affects payroll taxes - a statutory employee is defined as an employee by statute. Note that owners/partners are typically on the "Other Names" list in QuickBooks, but if listed as an employee their type will be `owner`.

hiredDate.description: The date this employee was hired, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

releasedDate.description: The date this employee was released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

birthDate.description: This employee's date of birth, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

accountNumber.description:
The employee's account number, which appears in the QuickBooks chart of accounts, reports, and graphs.

Note that if the "Use Account Numbers" preference is turned off in QuickBooks, the account number may not be visible in the user interface, but it can still be set and retrieved through the API.

targetBonus.description: The target bonus for this employee, represented as a decimal string. Found in the "employment job details" section of the employee's record in QuickBooks.

overtimeExemptStatus.description:
Whether this employee is exempt from overtime pay.

exempt, non_exempt

keyEmployeeStatus.description:
Whether this employee is a key employee.

none, key_employee, not_key_employee

originalHireDate.description: The original hire date for this employee, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

adjustedServiceDate.description: The adjusted service date for this employee, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). This date accounts for previous employment periods or leaves that affect seniority.

usCitizenshipStatus.description:
This employee's citizenship status.

citizen, non_citizen

i9OnFileStatus.description:
This employee's I-9 file status.

on_file, not_on_file

workAuthorizationExpirationDate.description: This employee's work authorization expiration date.

usVeteranStatus.description:
Whether this employee is a U.S. veteran.

veteran, non_veteran

militaryStatus.description: This employee's military status if they are a U.S. veteran.

externalId.description:
This is the external id of the employee, used to identify the employee in external systems.

GUID format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx

UpdateEstimateLineGroupRequest.description:
A request DTO for modifying an existing item group line on an Estimate.
Corresponds to EstimateLineGroupMod.

id.description: (Required) The TxnLineID of the specific group line you want to modify. (IDTYPE)

itemGroupId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the item group. (ItemGroupRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

unitOfMeasure.description: (Optional) Unit of measure for the quantity. (STRTYPE)

overrideUnitOfMSetId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Override Unit of Measure Set. (OverrideUOMSetRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

inventorySiteId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site. (InventorySiteRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

inventorySiteLocationId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site Location. (InventorySiteLocationRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

lines.description: (Optional) A list of modifications for the child lines *within* this group. (EstimateLineMod)

UpdateEstimateLineRequest.description:
EstimateLineMod One line of this estimate. Compare with EstimateLineGroup, which 
represents a previously defined group of lines in the estimate. In a Mod request, 
you can add a new line by supplying a TxnLineID value of -1.

txnLineId.description: (Required) The TxnLineID of the specific line item being modified or deleted. (IDTYPE)

id.description: (Required for Mod) The TxnLineID of the specific line item being modified or deleted. (IDTYPE)

objectType.description: The type of object. This value is always `"qbd_estimate"`.

itemId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the item for this line. (ItemRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

description.description: (Optional) Description for the line item. Max 4000 chars.

unitOfMeasure.description: (Optional) Unit of measure for the quantity. Max 31 chars.

rate.description: (Optional) The rate/price per item. Mutually exclusive with RatePercent, MarkupRate, MarkupRatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PRICETYPE)

ratePercent.description: (Optional) The percentage rate applied. Mutually exclusive with Rate, MarkupRate, MarkupRatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PERCENTTYPE)

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with this line item. (ClassRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

amount.description: (Optional) The total amount for the line item. Required if Rate/RatePercent is not specified. (AMTTYPE)

optionForPriceRuleConflict.description: (Optional) How QuickBooks should handle a price rule conflict. Valid values: Zero, BasePrice.

inventorySiteId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site. (InventorySiteRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

inventorySiteLocationId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site Location. (InventorySiteLocationRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

salesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Sales Tax Code. (SalesTaxCodeRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

markupRate.description: (Optional) A fixed markup rate. Mutually exclusive with MarkupRatePercent, Rate/RatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PRICETYPE)

markupRatePercent.description: (Optional) A percentage markup rate. Mutually exclusive with MarkupRate, Rate/RatePercent, and PriceLevelId. (PERCENTTYPE)

priceLevelId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Price Level. Mutually exclusive with Markup fields and Rate fields. (PriceLevelRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

overrideItemAccountId.description: (Optional, Add only) The ListID or FullName of the overriding Item Account. (OverrideItemAccountRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

customFields.description: (Optional, Add only) List of custom data extensions.

UpdateEstimateRequest.description:
Request model for modifying an existing Estimate in QuickBooks. Some fields in an
EstimateMod request cannot be cleared. If any of the following fields is included in
an estimate modify request, it must contain a value: CustomerRef, TemplateRef,
TxnDate, IsActive, CreateChangeOrder, DueDate, ItemSalesTaxRef

revisionNumber.description: (Required) The EditSequence number for optimistic locking. (STRTYPE)

customerId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job. Cannot be cleared. (CustomerRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with the entire transaction. (ClassRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

templateId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the template to use for the Estimate. Cannot be cleared. (TemplateRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The date of the transaction. Cannot be cleared. (DATETYPE)

refNumber.description: (Optional) The sequential reference number for the Estimate (e.g., Estimate Number). (STRTYPE)

isActive.description: (Optional) Whether the Estimate is active. Cannot be cleared. (BOOLTYPE)

createChangeOrder.description: (Optional) Indicates whether a Change Order should be created. (BOOLTYPE)

termsId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the payment terms for the Estimate. (TermsRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

dueDate.description: (Optional) The due date calculated from the terms. Cannot be cleared. (DATETYPE)

salesRepId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Sales Rep. (SalesRepRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

itemSalesTaxId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales tax item that applies to the entire Estimate. Cannot be cleared. (ItemSalesTaxRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

memo.description: (Optional) A memo for the entire transaction. (STRTYPE)

customerMessageId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Customer Message to appear on the form. (CustomerMsgRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

isToBeEmailed.description: (Optional) Whether the Estimate should be flagged to be emailed. (BOOLTYPE)

isTaxIncluded.description: (Optional) Whether tax is included in the line item amounts. (BOOLTYPE)

customerSalesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Customer Sales Tax Code. (CustomerSalesTaxCodeRef, Flattened-ID Pattern)

otherCustomField.description: (Optional) The Other field for the transaction. (STRTYPE)

exchangeRate.description: (Optional) The exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. (FLOATTYPE)

lines.description: (Optional) List of modifications for standard Estimate lines (EstimateLineMod). Use the inner 'TxnLineId' to specify Add/Mod/Delete.

lineGroups.description: (Optional) List of modifications for item group lines (EstimateLineGroupMod). Use the inner 'TxnLineId' to specify the group line to modify.

UpdateExpenseLineRequest.description:
A reusable request DTO for modifying an existing Expense Line on a transaction.
Based on the ExpenseLineMod QBXML type.

id.description:
(Required) The TxnLineID of the specific line you want to modify.
When modifying an existing QbdObject tht does not have a line item yet, use "-1" to add the first line.

accountId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the expense account.

amount.description: (Optional) The amount of the expense line.

memo.description: (Optional) A memo specific to this line item.

customerId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job.

classId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class.

vendorId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the vendor.

salesTaxCodeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales tax code.

salesRepresentativeId.description: (Optional) The ListID or FullName of the sales rep.

UpdateInventoryAdjustmentLineRequest.description: Represents a single line item modification for an Inventory Adjustment.

UpdateInventoryAdjustmentRequest.description:
A request model for modifying an existing Inventory Adjustment transaction.
Corresponds to the InventoryAdjustmentMod QBXML message.

revisionNumber.description:
(Required) The EditSequence is a sequence number value assigned to an object that is used for concurrency control. (Max 16 characters)
Implemented from IUpdateRequest.

accountId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Adjustment account.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for AccountRef.

transactionDate.description: (Optional) The new date of the transaction.

refNumber.description: (Optional) The new document number. (Max 11 characters)

inventorySiteId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the Inventory Site where the adjustment occurs.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for InventorySiteRef.

customerId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the customer or job related to the adjustment.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for CustomerRef.

classId.description:
(Optional) The ListID or FullName of the class associated with the transaction header.
Follows the Flattened-ID Pattern for ClassRef.

memo.description: (Optional) New general memo about the Inventory Adjustment. (Max 4095 characters)

inventoryAdjustmentLines.description: (Optional) A list of line item modifications for the adjustment.

externalId.description: (Optional) A GUID specified by the client to track the request asynchronously.

UpdateInventoryItemRequest.description:
Request for updating an existing inventory item.
Implements IUpdateRequest for the abstraction pattern.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this inventory item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two inventory items could both have the `name` "Cabinet", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Kitchen:Cabinet" and "Inventory:Cabinet".

barcode.description: The barcode associated with this inventory item.

classId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the Class linked to this inventory item.

parentId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the parent inventory item, if this is a sub-item.

sku.description:
The manufacturer part number for the inventory item.

Stored as SKU in the database layer.

unitOfMeasureSetId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the unit of measure set associated with this inventory item.

forceUOMChange.description: Indicates whether to force a unit of measure change.

isTaxIncluded.description: Indicates whether sales tax is included in the sales price.

salesTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the sales tax code associated with this inventory item.

salesDescription.description: Customer-facing description printed on sales documents like invoices and sales receipts.

salesPrice.description: The price at which this inventory item is sold to customers, represented as a decimal string.

incomeAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the income account used to track revenue from sales of this inventory item.

applyIncomeAccountRefToExistingTxns.description: Indicates whether to apply the income account reference to existing transactions retroactively.

purchaseDescription.description: Vendor-facing description printed on purchase forms like purchase orders or bills.

purchaseCost.description: The cost at which this inventory item is purchased from vendors, represented as a decimal string.

purchaseTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the purchase tax code.

cogsAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) account.

applyCOGSAccountRefToExistingTxns.description: Indicates whether to apply the COGS account reference to existing transactions retroactively.

preferredVendorId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the preferred vendor from whom this inventory item is typically purchased.

assetAccountId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the asset account used to track the current value of this inventory item in inventory.

reorderPoint.description: The minimum quantity of this inventory item at which QuickBooks prompts for reordering.

maximumQuantityOnHand.description: The maximum quantity of this inventory item to hold in inventory.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

revisionNumber.description:
Fulfills the IUpdateRequest interface.
Required for QuickBooks "Mod" operations for optimistic concurrency.

The concurrency sequencing token validated prior to modification.

name.description:
The case-insensitive unique name of this inventory site, unique across all inventory sites.

**NOTE**: Inventory sites do not have a `fullName` field because they are not hierarchical objects, which is why `name` is unique for them but not for objects that have parents.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory site is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

description.description: A description of this inventory site.

contact.description: The name of the primary contact person for this inventory site.

phone.description: The inventory site's primary telephone number.

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description:
Request model for updating an existing invoice.
Matches InvoiceModRq in QBXML.

revisionNumber.description: Edit sequence value for optimistic locking (required).

customerId.description: Customer ListID (optional for updates).

classId.description: Class ListID.

transactionDate.description: Transaction date.

refNumber.description: Reference number for the invoice.

isPending.description: Indicates whether this invoice has not been completed or is in a draft version.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The PoNumber associated with this object.

dueDate.description: Due date for the invoice.

shipmentOrigin.description: The Fob associated with this object.

shippingDate.description: The ShipDate associated with this object.

memo.description: Memo/description for the invoice.

otherCustomField.description: The Other associated with this object.

isQueuedForPrint.description: The IsToBePrinted associated with this object.

isQueuedForEmail.description: The IsToBeEmailed associated with this object.

isTaxIncluded.description: The isTaxIncluded associated with this object.

salesTaxCodeId.description: Customer Sales Tax Code ListID.

exchangeRate.description: The market exchange rate between this invoice's currency and the home currency in QuickBooks at the time of this transaction. Represented as a decimal value (e.g., 1.2345 for 1 EUR = 1.2345 USD if USD is the home currency).

applyCredits.description: Specific credit transactions to apply while updating the invoice.

lines.description: Item line items (replaces existing lines).

lineGroups.description: Item group line items for the invoice.

UpdateItemDiscountRequest.description: Request model for updating an ItemDiscount.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this discount item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two discount items could both have the `name` "10% labor discount", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Discounts:10% labor discount" and "Promotions:10% labor discount".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this discount item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

parentId.description:
The unique QuickBooks ListID of the parent discount item, if this is a sub-item.

Only applicable if this is a sub-item and hierarchy is enabled.

parentName.description: The fully qualified name of the parent discount item, if this is a sub-item.

itemDesc.description:
The customer-facing description printed on sales documents when applying this discount item.

Optional. If omitted, QuickBooks will use the default description set on the item itself.

salesTaxCodeId.description: The unique QuickBooks ListID of the default sales tax code applied to this discount item.

salesTaxCodeName.description: The name of the default sales tax code applied to this discount item.

discountRate.description:
The monetary amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction, represented as a decimal string.

**NOTE**: A flat rate discount applies to ALL lines recorded above it and distributes the discount amount equally across those lines, which affects tax calculations. For example, a $10 discount applied to a $100 taxable item and $100 non-taxable item would result in a $5 taxable discount and $5 non-taxable discount.

discountRatePercent.description:
The percentage amount to subtract from the total or subtotal when applying this discount item to a transaction.

**NOTE**: A percentage discount only applies to the line immediately above it, so tax implications only affect that specific line.

accountId.description:
The unique QuickBooks ListID of the posting account to which transactions involving this discount item are posted.

Must be an Expense or Income account.

accountName.description: The name of the posting account to which transactions involving this discount item are posted.

UpdateItemFixedAssetRequest.description: Request model for updating an ItemFixedAsset.

revisionNumber.description:
The current QuickBooks-assigned revision number of this object, which changes each time the object is modified.

When updating this record, you must provide the most recent revisionNumber/EditSequence to ensure you're working with the latest data; otherwise, the update will return an error.

name.description:
The name of the fixed asset item.
Max Length: 31 characters.

Must be unique among sibling items within the same hierarchy level. Case-insensitive.

isActive.description:
Whether the fixed asset item is active.

Inactive items are hidden in QuickBooks lists but preserved in historic data.

classId.description:
Reference to the Class.

Classes can be used to categorize objects into meaningful segments like departments or product lines.

acquiredAs.description:
Indicates the condition of the asset at the time of acquisition (e.g., "New" or "Used").

Helps track asset history and initial valuation constraints.

purchaseDescription.description:
A description of the asset specifically related to its purchase.

Stamped on procurement forms and purchase documentation.
purchaseDescription.example: Purchased from local dealership for logistics team

purchaseDate.description:
The date on which the business purchased or acquired the asset.

Tracks the acquisition calendar date.

purchaseCost.description:
The original purchase price or cost of acquiring the asset.

Represents the core asset cost.

vendorOrPayeeName.description:
The name of the vendor or payee from whom the asset was purchased.

Useful for warranty claims and supplier referencing.

assetAccountId.description:
The identifier of the specific Fixed Asset account in the Chart of Accounts used to track this asset's financial value.

Must reference an account of type FixedAsset.

salesDescription.description:
A description of the sales transaction or the reason for the asset's disposal.

Documenting the reason or parameters of the disposal.

salesPrice.description:
The final price for which the asset was sold.

The gross sale amount realized.

incomeAccountId.description:
The identifier of the asset's posting income account.

The general ledger revenue tracking account.

salesTaxCodeId.description:
The identifier of the sales tax code.

Mapped sales tax code identifying if this item is taxable.

assetDescription.description:
A general description of the fixed asset.

Main asset reference label.

location.description:
The physical location or department where the asset is currently kept.

Identifies geography or cost center.

purchaseOrderNumber.description:
The Purchase Order number associated with the acquisition of the asset.

Links the asset back to purchase history.

serialNumber.description:
The serial number or vehicle identification number (VIN) of the asset.

Unique hardware identification tag.

warrantyExpirationDate.description:
The date on which the manufacturer's or vendor's warranty for the asset expires.

Helps track active warranty timelines.

notes.description:
Additional free-form notes or comments regarding the asset.

Any miscellaneous asset-related observations.
notes.example: Minor scratch on passenger side door from 2020.

assetNumber.description:
A unique, company-assigned tracking number or barcode number for the asset.

Internal asset tracking code.

costBasis.description:
The cost basis of the asset used for calculating tax and depreciation.

Often includes purchase price plus freight, installation, etc.

yearEndAccumulatedDepreciation.description:
The total amount of depreciation accumulated for this asset up to the end of the most recent fiscal year.

Accumulated depreciation value.

yearEndBookValue.description:
The net book value of the asset at the end of the fiscal year.

Typically Cost Basis minus Accumulated Depreciation.

UpdateItemGroupLineRequest.description:
A reusable request DTO for modifying an existing Item Group Line on a transaction.

UpdateItemInventoryAssemblyRequest.description:
Request model for updating an ItemInventoryAssembly.
Updates an inventory assembly item. If you change the income account, 
set updateExistingTransactionsIncomeAccount to true so QuickBooks applies 
the new account to existing transactions that use the assembly.

Updating quantity on hand: The number of units of this inventory assembly
item currently in inventory. quantityOnHand multiplied by averageCost 
equals totalValue for inventory item lists. To change the quantityOnHand 
for an inventory assembly item, you must use an inventory-adjustment 
instead of updating the inventory assembly item directly.

name.description: The case-insensitive name of this inventory assembly item. Not guaranteed to be unique because it does not include the names of its hierarchical parent objects like `fullName` does. For example, two inventory assembly items could both have the `name` "Deluxe Kit", but they could have unique `fullName` values, such as "Assemblies:Deluxe Kit" and "Inventory:Deluxe Kit".

isActive.description: Indicates whether this inventory assembly item is active. Inactive objects are typically hidden from views and reports in QuickBooks. Defaults to `true`.

salesPrice.description: The price at which this inventory assembly item is sold to customers, represented as a decimal string.

purchaseCost.description: The cost at which this inventory assembly item is purchased from vendors, represented as a decimal string.

buildNotificationThreshold.description: The inventory assembly item's minimum quantity threshold that triggers a build notification in QuickBooks. When the sum of `quantityOnHand` (current inventory) and `quantityOnOrder` (pending purchase orders) drops below this threshold, QuickBooks will notify users that more units need to be built or assembled. This helps ensure adequate inventory levels for inventory assembly items.

maximumQuantityOnHand.description: The maximum quantity of this inventory assembly item desired in inventory.

lines.description: The inventory assembly item's lines.

id.description:

not just within its own type. This value is assigned by QuickBooks and never changes.

Only applicable if the QuickBooks company file has multi-currency enabled.

The market exchange rate between the transaction's currency and the home currency.

Only applicable if multi-currency is enabled.

refNumber.description:
A user-defined reference number for this transaction (e.g., check number, invoice number).

memo.description: A memo or note for the transaction that appears in registers and reports.

creditAmountInHomeCurrency.description: Note: The base AmountInHomeCurrency is a string. This is a decimal.

isTaxIncluded.description: (Optional) If true, the amount includes sales tax.

salesTaxCode.description:
The sales-tax code for this vendor credit, determining whether it is taxable or non-taxable. If set, this overrides any sales-tax codes defined on the vendor. This can be overridden on the vendor credit's individual lines.

Default codes include "Non" (non-taxable) and "Tax" (taxable), but custom codes can also be created in QuickBooks. If QuickBooks is not set up to charge sales tax (via the "Do You Charge Sales Tax?" preference), it will assign the default non-taxable code to all sales.

openAmount.description:
The remaining unapplied credit on this vendor credit, represented as a decimal string. This equals the original credit amount minus any amounts that have been applied to bills.

**NOTE**: This field is almost always present, but due to a known QBD bug, it can be absent in rare cases. If you ever encounter `openAmount` as `null`, we recommend the following fallback procedure: Re-query the vendor credits with `includeLinkedTransactions=true` and compute a fallback open amount as `creditAmount` minus the sum of `linkedTransactions[].amount` for all entries where `linkedTransactions[].linkType` is `"amount"`.

amountInHomeCurrency.description: The transaction amount converted into the QuickBooks company file's home currency.

hasValidLineItems.description: Internal validation helper to check if the transaction contains at least one valid line item.

externalId.description:
A globally unique identifier (GUID) provided by your application to track this record in an external system.

This field is immutable and can only be set during the initial creation of the transaction.

linkedTransactions.description:
Other transactions linked to this transaction (e.g., payments applied to an invoice, or purchase orders linked to a bill).

**Important:** QuickBooks does not always return linked transactions by default to optimize performance.
When querying lists of transactions, you may need to explicitly include a parameter (e.g., `includeLinkedTransactions=true`) to populate this array.

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of Accounts where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:

post.description:
**Typical flow:**
1. Create a connection in the portal (or via `POST /api/v1/connections`) and note its `connectionId`.
2. When your user is ready to connect QuickBooks, call this endpoint with that `connectionId`.
3. Redirect or link your user to the returned `authFlowUrl` — they complete the QWC setup from there.
   Creating a new auth session expires any older pending or in-progress setup links for that connection.
4. Poll `GET /api/v1/qwc-auth-setup/{connectionId}/status/authenticated` until `isConnected = true`.

**connectionId** — accepts the prefixed ID returned by `GET /api/v1/connections`,
a raw GUID, or your configured `externalId`.

**redirectUrl** (optional) — where to send the user after the QWC setup page completes.

**linkExpiryMins** (optional) — how long the auth setup URL remains valid, in minutes.
Defaults to 30 minutes. Maximum allowed value is 10,080 minutes (7 days).

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a list of BarCodes where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

get.description: Returns a list of BillingRates where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.

parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:

parameters.description:

not just within its own type. This value is assigned by QuickBooks and never changes.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Charges where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:

**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:

parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Checks where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
parameters.name: fields

get.description: Returns a paginated list of QbdClasss where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

get.summary: Returns all QuickBooks connections for your account.

post.description:
**mode** — for API-key-authenticated requests, mode is derived from the key type:
`sk_test_*` creates development connections and `sk_live_*` creates
production connections. Cookie-authenticated management requests still honor the
request body's `mode` value.
Production connections are created immediately, but remain non-operational until
Stripe billing is completed. The response includes billing redirect details.

**externalId** — your own identifier for this connection (e.g. your customer or user ID).
Must be unique within your account. Once set, it can be used anywhere a
`connectionId` is accepted, so you never need to store our internal IDs.

post.summary:
Runs a live connectivity probe against the connection's QuickBooks Desktop.

This is a real round-trip, not a status read: it enqueues a lightweight company query
and waits briefly for the QuickBooks Web Connector to execute it. A `responding: true`
result means QuickBooks Desktop is running, the Web Connector is polling, and the bound
company file is open right now. If the connector does not answer within the probe window,
`responding` is false — QuickBooks is not currently reachable.

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.

post.summary:
Tells the backend that the client is done consuming the given paginated cursor.
The SOAP iterator-continuation hold (up to ~10s waiting for the next "continue")
unblocks immediately, the QWC lane frees, and the underlying job is marked
`Completed` by the SOAP side.

Idempotent: calling on an unknown / already-closed cursor returns 204 with no
observable side effect. Safe for SDK `finally` blocks and user-driven retry.

Tenant-scoped: only signals when the live session belongs to the caller's tenant.
Cross-tenant requests silently return 204 (do NOT leak whether the cursor existed).

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

get.description: Returns a list of CustomerTypes where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
