get.description: Returns a paginated list of Customers where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList

parameters.description: Optional: Filter by job status (customer-specific filter)
parameters.name: JobStatus

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

parameters.description: Filter by specific Class IDs.
parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description:
PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION: Exclude ShipToAddress data from the response.
QuickBooks SDK strongly recommends excluding ship addresses unless specifically needed,
as it significantly improves query performance.
Default: true (ship addresses excluded for better performance)
init to false if you need shipping address data.
Example: ?excludeShipToAddress=false
parameters.name: excludeShipToAddress

get.description: Returns a paginated list of DateDrivenTerms where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Deposits where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs
parameters.name: accountIds

parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)
parameters.name: entityIds

parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs
parameters.name: itemIds

parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.
parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.
parameters.name: vendorId

parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)
parameters.name: includeLineItems

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.
parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description:
(Optional) Filter by owner GUIDs.
This is a QuickBooks-specific filter for multi-user environments.
Example: ["{12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012}", "{87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321}"]
parameters.name: OwnerIDs

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

List and streaming query operations accept **1–90** seconds (default **90**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

get.description: Returns a list of Employees where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Estimates where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

get.description: Returns a list of InventorySites where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ItemReceipts where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs
parameters.name: accountIds

parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)
parameters.name: entityIds

parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs
parameters.name: itemIds

parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.
parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.
parameters.name: vendorId

parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)
parameters.name: includeLineItems

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.
parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date range - end date.

parameters.description: Filter by RefNumber (transaction reference).
parameters.name: RefNumber

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ListID.

get.description: Returns a list of OtherNames where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:

Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of PurchaseOrders where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.

parameters.description:

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

parameters.description:
The date from which to calculate aging in an Aging report.
Valid values: "ReportEndDate" (default), "Today"
Only applies to Aging report types.
parameters.name: AgingAsOf

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: Cursor

parameters.description:
If true, the report will be displayed in QuickBooks Desktop after generation.
If false or null, the report is only returned via QBXML without displaying.
parameters.name: DisplayReport

parameters.description:
Filter which accounts to include in the Aging report.
Valid values: "All", "InUse"
Only applies to Aging report types.
parameters.name: IncludeAccounts

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return in a single response.
parameters.name: Limit

parameters.description:
A predefined date range macro (e.g., "ThisMonth", "LastYear", "Today").
Corresponds to the 'period' parameter in common web APIs.
Cannot be used with FromReportDate/ToReportDate.
parameters.name: Period

parameters.description: The accounting basis for the report (e.g., "Accrual", "Cash", "None").
parameters.name: ReportBasis

parameters.description:
The type of report being requested (e.g., "ProfitAndLoss", "BalanceSheet", "GeneralDetail").
Required for generating the correct QBXML request.


Valid values: "1099Detail", "AuditTrail", "BalanceSheetDetail", "CheckDetail", "CustomerBalanceDetail", "DepositDetail", "EstimatesByJob", "ExpenseByVendorDetail", "GeneralLedger", "IncomeByCustomerDetail", "IncomeTaxDetail", "InventoryValuationDetail", "JobProgressInvoicesVsEstimates", "Journal", "MissingChecks", "OpenInvoices", "OpenPOs", "OpenPOsByJob", "OpenSalesOrderByCustomer", "OpenSalesOrderByItem", "PendingSales", "ProfitAndLossDetail", "PurchaseByItemDetail", "PurchaseByVendorDetail", "SalesByCustomerDetail", "SalesByItemDetail", "SalesByRepDetail", "TxnDetailByAccount", "TxnListByCustomer", "TxnListByDate", "TxnListByVendor", "UnpaidBillsDetail", "UnbilledCostsByJob", "VendorBalanceDetail"
parameters.name: ReportType

parameters.description: Specifies how to summarize/group report rows (e.g., "Account", "Customer", "TotalOnly").
parameters.name: SummarizeRowsBy

parameters.description: Valid values: TimeByItem, TimeByJobDetail, TimeByJobSummary, TimeByName
parameters.name: TimeType

get.description: Returns a paginated list of SalesOrders where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs

parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)
parameters.name: entityIds

parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs
parameters.name: itemIds

parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.

parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.

parameters.name: includeLineItems

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.
parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions

parameters.description:
SalesOrder-specific override: accepts friendly camelCase JSON field names
(e.g. "customer", "shipMethod", "referenceNumber") and translates them at set-time
into the QBXML field names that QuickBooks Desktop expects inside <IncludeRetElement>.
Raw QBXML names (e.g. "CustomerRef") still pass through unchanged.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description:

get.description: Returns a paginated list of SalesReceipts where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set

get.description: Returns a list of SalesTaxCodes where the default limit is 500. **Note: Cursor-based pagination is NOT supported for this resource, so all available records (up to the limit) will be returned in a single response.**

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:

parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:

The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the queued job to be picked up and the response returned from QuickBooks Desktop.

Create / update / delete and single-entity retrieval operations accept **1–120** seconds (default **120**). Raise this when the QuickBooks Web Connector is configured with longer polling intervals or the target company file is slow to respond.

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
parameters.name: X-Nxus-Timeout-Seconds

The publishable key is a stable, tenant-level credential used as the ?pk= query parameter
when directing end users to your hosted QWC setup page:

  https://yourapp.com/connect/{connectionId}?pk={publishableKey}

Unlike the secret API key, the publishable key is safe to embed in client-side code.
It does NOT rotate when you rotate secret API keys.
Use POST /api/v1/tenant/me/rotate-publishable-key to intentionally rotate it.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Terms where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList

get.description: Returns a paginated list of TimeTrackings where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs
parameters.name: accountIds

parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)
parameters.name: entityIds

parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs
parameters.name: itemIds

parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.
parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.
parameters.name: vendorId

parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)
parameters.name: includeLineItems

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.
parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: (Optional) A single transaction ID (TxnID) to retrieve a specific Time Tracking entry.
parameters.name: Id

parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by the entity (Employee, Vendor, OtherName) associated with the time entry.
parameters.name: TimeTrackingEntityFilter

This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Transactions where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more reference numbers.

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (end).
parameters.name: toTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by transaction date (start).
parameters.name: fromTransactionDate

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberStartsWith

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (start).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: refNumberFrom

parameters.description:
Reference number range filter (end).

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `refNumberFrom` and `refNumberTo` are specified, `refNumberTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: refNumberTo

parameters.description: Filter by Account IDs
parameters.name: accountIds

parameters.description: Filter by Entity IDs (Customers, Vendors, Employees)
parameters.name: entityIds

parameters.description: Filter by Item IDs
parameters.name: itemIds

parameters.description:
Filter by Class IDs

Provide a list of strictly matched ClassIDs.
parameters.name: classIds

parameters.description: Filter by Vendor ID.
parameters.name: vendorId

parameters.description:
Whether to include line items (ExpenseLines, ItemLines, ItemGroupLines) in the response.
Only applies to transaction objects that support line items (Bills, Checks, Invoices, etc.)
parameters.name: includeLineItems

parameters.description: Whether to include linked transactions in the response.
parameters.name: includeLinkedTransactions

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Filter by Currency ListIDs.
parameters.name: CurrencyIds

parameters.description:
Transaction Detail Level: "all", "transaction_lines_only", "transactions_without_lines"
QBXML maps to: All, AllExceptSummary, SummaryOnly

<value>all</value>
<value>transaction_lines_only</value>
<value>transactions_without_lines</value>

parameters.description: Filter by Payment Status: "open", "closed"

parameters.description:
Filter transactions by transaction type.
Available options: all, ar_refund_credit_card, bill, bill_payment_check, bill_payment_credit_card, build_assembly, 
charge, check, credit_card_charge, credit_card_credit, credit_memo, deposit, estimate, inventory_adjustment, invoice, 
item_receipt, journal_entry, liability_adjustment, paycheck, payroll_liability_check, purchase_order, receive_payment, 
sales_order, sales_receipt, sales_tax_payment_check, transfer, vendor_credit, ytd_adjustment
parameters.name: TransactionTypes

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return for this request.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:

parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL

parameters.description:

parameters.description:

parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:

parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:

parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:

parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (TxnIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched TxnIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` exactly matches any of the provided values.
parameters.name: refNumbers

parameters.description:
Filter by reference number (substring match).

Returns transactions where the `RefNumber` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: refNumberContains

parameters.description:

parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:

parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description: Filter by starting reference number (startsWith).

parameters.description: Filter by ending reference number (endsWith).
parameters.name: refNumberEndsWith

parameters.description:

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or after this value.

Use this to return transactions whose reference number is alphabetically at or before this value.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of VendorTypes where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Vendors where the default limit is 150.

parameters.description:
The pagination cursor token used to retrieve the next set of records.

Capture the `nextCursor` from the response JSON and provide it here to continue fetching data.


**The 10-Second Rule:** Due to QuickBooks Desktop architectural requirements, you must request
the next page within **10 seconds** of receiving the previous response.


**Static Cursors:** Unlike some APIs, the cursor remains constant for the entire duration
of the fetch sequence until `hasMore` is `false`.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more unique identifiers (ListIDs).

Provide a list of strictly matched ListIDs. This is the most efficient way to retrieve specific records.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
Filter by one or more exact full names.

Returns records whose `FullName` exactly matches any of the provided strings.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: fullnames

parameters.description: Shortcut for Filters.ActiveStatus - Filter by active status enum: ActiveOnly InactiveOnly ALL
parameters.name: activeStatus

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or before this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **23:59:59** (end of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedBefore

parameters.description:
Filter for records modified on or after this date.

**Time Defaults:** If a time is not specified, local time **00:00:00** (beginning of day) is assumed.


**Range:** Supports dates from 1970-01-01 to 2038-01-18.
parameters.name: updatedAfter

parameters.description:
Filter by name (substring match).

Matches records where the `FullName` contains this string.
Case-insensitive according to QuickBooks Desktop rules.
parameters.name: nameContains

parameters.description:
Return records whose name starts with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` begins with this string.
Example: Searching "Mac" returns "MacPherson", "MacGyver", etc.
parameters.name: nameStartsWith

parameters.description:
Return records whose name ends with this value.

Matches records where the `FullName` finishes with this string.
Example: Searching "kitchen" returns "John's Kitchen", "Central Kitchen", etc.
parameters.name: nameEndsWith

parameters.description:
Name range filter (start).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or after this value.
parameters.name: nameFrom

parameters.description:
Name range filter (end).

Returns records whose name is alphabetically at or before this value.
If both `nameFrom` and `nameTo` are specified, `nameTo` must be lexicographically higher.
parameters.name: nameTo

parameters.description:
Limit the response to only these top-level fields. Names must match exactly (case-sensitive QbXML element names e.g. ListIDRet, NameRet, AddressRet, PhoneRet  ).

**Note:** The names specified in the list are not parsed, so you must be especially careful to supply valid
names, properly cased. No error is returned in the status code if you specify an invalid name. Notice that if you want to
return custom data or private data extensions, you must specify the DataExtRet element and you must supply the OwnerID set
to either a value of 0 (custom data) or the GUID for the private data.
<example>["ListIDRet", "NameRet", "AddressRet", "PhoneRet"]</example>
parameters.name: IncludeRetElementList

parameters.description:
Identifies which QuickBooks Desktop company file to target.

Accepts three formats:
- **Prefixed ID**: `conn_01965a3f2e7b7000b4c1d2e3f4a5b6c7`
- **Internal GUID**: `3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6`
- **Your external ID**: `acme-corp` (the `externalId` you assigned when creating the connection)

The middleware resolves any of these formats to the correct connection. Required for all QuickBooks resource operations — without it, the API cannot determine which company file to query.
parameters.name: X-Connection-Id

parameters.description:
A unique identifier for tracing a single request through the entire system.
If not provided by the client, a new one will be generated.
This is not persisted and is used only for logging and monitoring.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

Passed as a request header — not a query-string value.
